digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter and reconciler capability system
propositions: Epic-field capability map reports must be validated post-run and refuse to vouch for unverifiable contracts, exiting non-zero with verdict in run_metadata.json
Capability call sites must be runtime-guarded using isinstance-primary logic with hasattr fallback to prevent silent failures when capabilities are absent
Dormant absence-probe port and its associated units (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, probe_remote implementations) must be deleted from codebase
Capability-absent vs capability-raised states must be reported distinctly on bridge_alerts channel as INFO-level skips rather than hard failures
Post-run Epic-field validation must be proven by unit test pinning a system-only field inventory as not-ready on the validation surface
Three changes (1642, 1634, 1645) must not regress live DC harness and must not introduce new test deletions, skips, or xfails beyond pre-existing markers
